questions.question: What sin is the prince of Tyre condemned for in Ezekiel 28?
options: Greed: hoarding up to himself the great wealth of many lands
Idolatry: bowing down to worship all of the gods of the sea
Pride: claiming to be a god, though he is but a man
Cruelty: harshly enslaving all of the people of Judah
questions.answer: Pride: claiming to be a god, though he is but a man

questions.question: How is the king of Tyre described before his fall in the lament?
options: Full of wisdom and beauty, in Eden, until unrighteousness was found in him
A wise and very patient judge who ruled all of the people with great justice
Poor and lowly, but raised up from nothing to rule over the wealthy city
A mighty warrior who had never even once lost a single battle in the field
questions.answer: Full of wisdom and beauty, in Eden, until unrighteousness was found in him

questions.question: Ezekiel 28 also pronounces judgment on Sidon.
Your heart is _____, and you have said, 'I am a god,' yet you are but a man.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until _____ was found in you.
